name: Cosmic Scale
description: Planets and stars at their true relative sizes in a deep starfield, built in Three.js with textures painted in code, and a camera that pulls back in big log-scale moves to reveal the scale.
best_use_cases: Showing how big things really are
style: 3D in Three.js: every body uses its true radius relative to the others, surfaces painted in code, the camera moves on a log scale so each pull-back feels like the same size of jump, with thin labels carrying the real size.
